name: Desk Notes Lite
description:
Desk Notes Lite turns XENEON Edge into the sticky note board that should have shipped with it. Keep today’s reminders, quick notes, and checklist items permanently visible underneath your monitor instead of losing them behind desktop windows.

Use the iCUE settings panel to give the board a custom title and fill up to eight native Entry fields. Plain entries render as notes, while entries beginning with [ ] become touch friendly checklist items you can complete directly on XENEON Edge. Completed items stay visible but de-emphasized so you keep context instead of watching tasks vanish.

Choose from six note themes, adjust font sizing, and personalize text, accent, background, and transparency. Completion state persists locally per widget instance.

No account, cloud service, API key, helper app, unsupported keyboard capture, or recurring maintenance dependency is required. Desk Notes Lite supports all eight XENEON Edge slot layouts in horizontal and vertical orientations.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for XENEON Edge.
release_notes:
• One persistent note board with up to eight native iCUE Entry fields
• Mixed plain notes and touch-friendly checklist items
• Custom board title, six themes, responsive font sizing, and appearance controls
• Local checklist completion persistence
• Support for all eight XENEON Edge layouts
